ROW 2461 | note_type=OPERATIVE NOTE | author=Ocean Reyes-Tran DDS Pinecrest Pediatric Dental - ORAL SURGERY / PROCEDURE NOTE Patient: M1RACLE FROST M1RACLE FROST DOB: 05/19/2067 Age: 6 MRN: FC-0482913 (our chart PD-30771) Date of procedure: 06/26/2073 Surgeon: Ocean Reyes-Tran, DDS Assist: Tre Walker (hygienist) Room: Op 3
Pre-op dx: infected lower left primary molar (onset 06/25/2073) Post-op dx: same Procedure: simple extraction of tooth, plus bitewing X-rays, scaling (supra + subgingival), desensitizing application
- consent signed by mother Justice Frost, father Royal Frost waiting outside - local anesth, no sedation. Pt tolerated well, cooperative - tooth removed intact, gauze, hemostasis in 5 min - gingiva exam: mild gingivitis - oral hygiene education given to pt and mom, brush 2x daily - post-op: soft diet today, acetaminophen PRN, no straw. Return if swelling or fever - fluoride NOT done today, pt's sibling Sky is booked for it next wk instead
Plate in lot (parked in fire lane): HOPE-22 -- reception paged dad. Pt asked if the tooth fairy knows her name "its Miracle, like in a miracle" Pt ID bracelet read "Miracle Frosst" - corrected. Ocean Reyes-Tran, DDS e-signed 06/26/2073 10:55
